answer: The net loft smells of tar and hemp, and the half-made nets hang from the rafters. Proof of netmaker via mesh knot tally — a mesh the netmaker knots only after 34 meshes hold true under the pull, each mesh knotted by the netmaker himself. ripple knots the first row to the headline and pulls each knot tight. dune checks the mesh with the gauge, every opening the same size. anchor tar-coats the finished net and hangs it to dry in the wind. A forger needs 34 meshes that all hold under the pull, and the next one still slips where the knot ran loose.
